claim.value: Reproducible differences under common conditions would characterize relative retention at requirements or readiness constraints.
claim.scope: Conditional characterization of relative retention, not identification of its cause.

provenance.rationale: P018 states the characterization; P027 explicitly limits causal interpretation.

signal_basis.value: Reproducible differences in milestone position, waiting duration, returns to active work and time to first publication under common conditions characterize how long trajectories remain at the mapped requirements or readiness constraints.
signal_basis.scope: Prospective cohort under the same onboarding pathway and observation conditions, comparing like windows and accounting for censored trajectories and accounts with no return.

provenance.rationale: The cited spans supply the observed dimensions, mapped retention locations, reproducibility condition and observation-window qualifications.
The bounded descriptive claim is supported without an additional unresolved empirical relation.

rationale: Given the stipulated reproducible signal and observation conditions, differences in where trajectories pause and how long they wait directly characterize relative retention. This licenses the descriptive claim without identifying which requirement or readiness constraint caused the delay.
uncertainty: Underlying causes remain unresolved; this does not defeat the explicitly noncausal characterization.
